title: Betting App Novig Raises $75 Million As It Joins Prediction Market Wave (Forbes)
notes: Forbes (Hank Tucker), 2026-02-18. Novig $75M Series B led by Pantera Capital at $500M valuation. Cofounders Jacob Fortinsky (CEO) + Kelechi Ukah; met at Harvard; started 2021. Applied for CFTC designated contract market approval; pivots: sports betting -> sweepstakes (late 2024) -> prediction market; chasing Kalshi/Polymarket.
